name: aesgcm
description: AES-128-GCM and AES-256-GCM (NIST SP 800-38D, TLS 1.3's 12-byte nonce and 16-byte tag), sealed and opened in place, on AES and carry-less multiply instructions where the CPU has them and constant-time portable code elsewhere; a SealingKey and an OpeningKey that number their own nonces (IV XOR the record's number, as TLS 1.3) and refuse past 2^64 - 1, seal_with_nonce and open_with_nonce for a nonce of the caller's, a tag that must be used, key schedules wiped when dropped.
